This report is generated from the case files in `testing/cases/` — the same
files `testing/run.R` executes. It auto-discovers every case, so adding or
removing a `.R` file there is all it takes to change the suite.
Knit from the package root with:

```
Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('testing/report.Rmd')"
```

To keep a progress snapshot, rename the resulting `report.html` (e.g.
`report 2026-07-06.html`) and move it into `testing/archive/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# rmarkdown knits with the working directory set to testing/; the case files
# use paths relative to the package root, so point knitr there.
if (!file.exists("DESCRIPTION") && file.exists("../DESCRIPTION")) {
  knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
```

```{r load, include=FALSE}
source("testing/_setup.R")
```

# Overview {.tabset .tabset-pills}

## Hide

## Show

```{r overview}
case_files <- sort(list.files("testing/cases", pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE))
meta <- lapply(case_files, parse_case_header)
overview <- data.frame(
  Case     = vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "id"),
  Type     = vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "type"),
  Function = vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "func"),
  Expect   = vapply(meta, function(m) {
    e <- ifelse(is.na(m$expect), "", m$expect)
    if (nchar(e) > 110) paste0(substr(e, 1, 110), "...") else e
  }, "")
)
knitr::kable(overview, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Cases

```{r generate-cases, results='asis'}
preferred <- c("geom_slice", "geom_fit", "slice_2d", "add_slice_2d",
               "drawit", "geom_add_slice_2d", "lm_equation", "error handling")
funcs <- vapply(meta, `[[`, "", "func")
func_order <- c(intersect(preferred, funcs), setdiff(unique(funcs), preferred))

blocks <- character()
for (fn in func_order) {
  blocks <- c(blocks, sprintf("## %s {.tabset .tabset-pills}\n", fn))
  for (i in which(funcs == fn)) {
    m <- meta[[i]]
    expect <- ifelse(is.na(m$expect), "(no EXPECT header)", m$expect)
    ref_png <- file.path("testing/reference", paste0(m$id, ".png"))
    ref_tag <- if (file.exists(ref_png)) {
      # src is resolved by pandoc relative to this Rmd (testing/), width in px
      # matches the rendered chunk figure so the two compare at the same scale
      sprintf('**Reference (ground truth):**\n\n<img src="reference/%s.png" width="%d">\n',
              m$id, round(m$width * 72))
    } else ""
    blocks <- c(blocks, sprintf(
      paste0('### %s\n\n> **Expect:** %s\n\n',
             '```{r %s, code = xfun::read_utf8("testing/cases/%s.R"), ',
             'fig.width = %s, fig.height = %s}\n```\n\n%s\n'),
      m$id, expect, m$id, m$id, m$width, m$height, ref_tag))
  }
}
cat(knitr::knit_child(text = paste(blocks, collapse = "\n"), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
```
